meta.summary: An order's life as states, left to right: paid, packed, shipped and delivered, cancelled on a timeout or a refund, and back to packed when it is returned; one run goes round the return once.

mkp-cs:protocol@1.name: protocol
mkp-cs:protocol@1.about: A protocol's states and transitions: step through a run of events and watch the current state move along its transitions.

inputs.name: states
inputs.about: the states; the first is where a run starts (names without spaces read best in Mermaid)

inputs.name: moves
inputs.about: the transitions: from a state, on an event, to a state, and a dashed or dotted line

inputs.name: run
inputs.about: the events of one run, in order

inputs.name: marks
inputs.about: states to mark: a tone (info, ok, warn, bad, accent) and a note under the name

inputs.name: dir
inputs.about: top down, or left to right

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of diagram it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the title

values.name: next
values.body: find(moves, m => m.from == s and m.on == ev, {from: s, to: s, on: "", line: solid}).to

values.name: known
values.body: len(filter(moves, m => m.from == s and m.on == ev)) > 0

values.name: path
comment: the state before each event, and after the last

values.name: near

value.expr: iterate(put({}, start, 0), len(states), d => fold(moves, d, (d2, m) => if(has(d2, m.from) and get(d2, m.to, 1000) > d2[m.from] + 1, put(d2, m.to, d2[m.from] + 1), d2)))

comment: each state's distance from the start along the transitions

values.name: reach
values.body: iterate(put({}, s, true), len(states), d => fold(moves, d, (d2, m) => if(has(d2, m.from), put(d2, m.to, true), d2)))
comment: the states a state leads to

values.name: ahead

value.expr: filter(moves, m => not (get(near, m.to, 0) <= get(near, m.from, 0) and has(reach(m.to), m.from)))

comment: a move to a state no further out that leads back round to it closes a loop; the others set
the layers, each state on the longest path to it, so a state reached two ways sits past both

value.expr: iterate(fold(states, {}, (d, s) => put(d, s, 0)), len(states), d => fold(filter(ahead, m => m.from != m.to and has(d, m.from) and has(d, m.to)), d, (d2, m) => put(d2, m.to, max(d2[m.to], d2[m.from] + 1))))
filter(map(range(0, depth), r => filter(states, s => get(rank, s, 0) == r)), l => len(l) > 0)

values.name: good

value.expr: filter(moves, m => indexof(states, m.from) >= 0 and indexof(states, m.to) >= 0)

comment: a move's event sits beside its line in a row of its own, and a move that runs back up or
across a layer runs through a lane in each row it crosses (route.mkp)

value.expr: map(good, m => {from: m.from, to: m.to, label: m.on})

values.name: backs

value.expr: flatten(map(filter(range(0, len(good) - 1), k => get(rank, good[k].to, 0) < get(rank, good[k].from, 0)), k => lay.via[k]))

comment: left to right, a move back sits first in each column it crosses, so it meets its ends level
with the moves going on, its event under it

value.expr: if(dir == right, map(lay.rows, r => map(sort(r, c => if(indexof(backs, c.id) >= 0, 0, 1)), c => {id: c.id, row: c.row, label: c.label, kind: if(c.kind == "label" and indexof(backs, c.id) >= 0, "back", c.kind)})), lay.rows)
if(pos > 0, indexof(map(good, m => m.from + ">" + m.on), path[pos - 1] + ">" + run[pos - 1]), -1)

values.name: mark
values.body: find(marks, m => m.state == s, {state: s, tone: "", note: ""})

value.expr: map(states, s => {id: s, tone: mark(s).tone, note: mark(s).note, on: s == here, icon: if(s == start, "play", if(len(filter(good, m => m.from == s and m.to != s)) == 0, "flag", ""))})
map(range(0, len(good) - 1), k => {from: good[k].from, to: good[k].to, via: lay.via[k], line: good[k].line, lit: k == took})

values.name: said
values.body: "**" + run[k] + "**: " + path[k] + " → " + path[k + 1] + if(known(path[k], run[k]), ".", " (no transition: it stays).")

status.expr: if(pos == 0, "Start in **" + start + "**." + if(len(run) > 0, " Next: " + run[0] + ".", ""), said(pos - 1) + if(pos < len(run), " Next: " + run[pos] + ".", ""))

mermaid.expr:
"stateDiagram-v2
  " + "[" + "*] --> " + start + "
" + join(map(moves, m => "  " + m.from + " --> " + m.to + " : " + m.on), "
")

md.expr:

" + join(map(range(0, len(run) - 1), k => "" + (k + 1) + ". " + run[k] + ": " + path[k] + " → " + path[k + 1] + if(known(path[k], run[k]), "", " (no transition: it stays)")), "
") + "
"
